actions.name: enslave
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} targets one creature it can see within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=TgxTvzC6OmS8hIUb]] of it. The target must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or be magically &Reference[charmed] by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} until the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies or until it is on a different plane of existence from the target. The charmed target is under the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s control and can't take reactions, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance. Whenever the charmed target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends. No more than once every 24 hours, the target can also repeat the saving throw when it is at least 1 mile away from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}.

actions.name: psychic drain
actions.desc: One creature &reference[charmed apply=false] by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes [[/damage average]] damage, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} regains hit points equal to the damage the creature takes.

actions.name: mucous cloud
actions.desc: While underwater, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is surrounded by transformative mucus. A creature that touches the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} or that hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft. of it must make a [[/save]] saving throw. On a failure, the creature is diseased for [[/r 1d4]] hours. The diseased creature can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: probing telepathy
actions.desc: If a creature communicates telepathically with the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} learns the creature's greatest desires if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see the creature.

actions.name: tentacle
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become diseased. The disease has no effect for 1 minute and can be removed by any magic that cures disease. After 1 minute, the diseased creature's skin becomes translucent and slimy, the creature can't regain hit points unless it is underwater, and the disease can be removed only by @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.qcYitWoSMTnKkzM1]{Heal} or another disease-curing spell of 6th level or higher. When the creature is outside a body of water, it takes [[/damage average 1d12 acid]] damage every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to the skin before 10 minutes have passed.

actions.name: amphibious
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe air and water.

actions.name: detect
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.
